items.html: And in Atzilut itself, too, there are degrees; for at first, through the aforementioned upper Ibur [conception], they began to sort the finest of them all, and from it the Nukva of Atik was made, after the light of the sparks of the 288 sparks had mixed with the light of the point of Keter that remained in Atzilut, and the vessels of the kings, too, had mixed with the new vessels of the new MA; and from all of it were made the Nukva of Atik and Atik, and in this manner with all of them. And afterwards, through the coupling of the male of Atik with the Nukva, they raised and sorted the sparks that had fallen below — the part fit for the Nukva of Arich — and they entered the place of the Ibur, in the secret of MAN [Mayin Nukvin]; and there they are sweetened and corrected through having been there for the duration of the Ibur, and they become a Partzuf.
